description: Next arrivals and the timetable at a public transit station. Give `city` (nyc, boston, bay-area, chicago, london) and `station` (a station id from transit_city, or a name to match). Answers the station (lines, place, step-free), `arrivals` (line, toward, due time, minutes away; live from the agency) and `schedule` (per line and direction on weekdays, Saturday and Sunday: first and last departure, trips and busiest hour).

station.description: Station id or name, e.g. 127 or Times Sq

name: transit_station
title: Transit Station Arrivals
